=== enter between braces
--- before
a {¦}
--- keys
<enter>
--- after
a {
    ¦
}

=== electric closer
--- before
a {
    color: red;
    ¦
--- keys
}
--- after
a {
    color: red;
}¦

=== autoclose paren
--- before
a { color: rgb¦ }
--- keys
(1
--- after
a { color: rgb(1¦) }

=== string
--- before
a { content: ¦ }
--- keys
"x
--- after
a { content: "x¦" }

=== comment toggle
--- before
«a { }
b { }»
--- keys
<lc>
--- after
«/* a { } */
/* b { } */»

=== comment toggle off
--- before
«/* a { } */»
--- keys
<lc>
--- after
«a { }»

=== block comment
--- before
a { «color: red;» }
--- keys
<bc>
--- after
a { «/* color: red; */» }

=== surround
--- before
a { width: «1px» }
--- keys
(
--- after
a { width: («1px») }

=== brackets attribute
--- before
a¦ {}
--- keys
[href
--- after
a[href¦] {}

=== nested
--- before
@media x {
    a {¦}
}
--- keys
<enter>
--- after
@media x {
    a {
        ¦
    }
}
